bullets.text: Engineering managers at mid-size backend teams who care about reliability and on-call practices.
Senior backend engineers at companies of a similar size to Acme Corp, especially ones posting about distributed systems.
Technical leads who've recently written about scaling a backend team, since they're likely open to a conversation.
LinkedIn groups and hashtags focused on backend engineering and distributed systems.
Comment threads under posts about on-call ownership and incident response -- a natural fit for your background.
Discussions tagged with system design, where thoughtful, specific comments stand out.

sections.heading: A realistic weekly cadence
sections.body: Aim for two to three genuine interactions a week -- a thoughtful comment, a reply to someone who engaged with your post, or a short message to someone you already share a real connection with. Consistency over a few months matters far more than a burst of outreach in one week.

sections.heading: Warm-intro paths through your existing network

bullets.text: Reconnect with former colleagues from your time at Acme Corp -- they already know your work firsthand.
Ask a former teammate to introduce you to someone on their current team if your paths have diverged.
